name: Muster for herdr
author: Oscar Felcan
description: Muster, the herdr plugin that keeps watch over your coding agents, in the Omarchy bar: what needs you across every agent, each agent's tile, and the orchestrator's last word.

barWidget.description: What needs you across every herdr agent, read from Muster's snapshot. Click a row to land on its pane.

schema.label: Muster state directory
schema.description: Where musterd writes snapshot.json. Empty means ~/.local/state/herdr/plugins/muster.

schema.label: muster binary
schema.description: The muster command to run. A bare name is looked up on PATH, then in the tab bar entry muster install wrote to your herdr config.
